I have the full chain in `guava/src/com/google/common/cache/LocalCache.java`. On a read, `Segment.get` finds a live entry and calls `scheduleRefresh`, which checks `refreshes()` and the write-time threshold, then calls `refresh`, which calls `insertLoadingValueReference` to claim the refresh and `loadAsync` to start the load; when the load completes (synchronously or via listener) `getAndRecordStats` runs and calls `storeLoadedValue` to install the new value.

ANSWER: Segment.get → Segment.scheduleRefresh → Segment.refresh → Segment.insertLoadingValueReference → Segment.loadAsync → (loadingValueReference.loadFuture, then on completion) Segment.getAndRecordStats → Segment.storeLoadedValue
